junction: Continuous exterior with a tilted removable throat joint; no external flange.
cavity_note: Gross enclosed cavity before neck overlap, sensor envelopes, walls around mounts or cooling hardware.
assembly_sequence: Bolt each neck half to the exposed front crossmember; leave screws loose.
Lay cables in the channel; close the halves with three side M3 screws and tighten root fasteners.
Install the head using two M4 screws from inside the open enclosure; connect sensors.
Fit the head lid and body cover.
manufacturing_note: Side halves fit within roughly 160 x 54 mm in the split plane. Print split-face down; local counterbores may require supports. Fit, strength and tool-access qualification remain provisional.
